title: Config types
label: Text (string)
ratio_help: Double spin box. suffix is display-only
strength_help: Slider. sync=True saves after 0.5s idle (no reload)
lut_help: File picker. DB stores a string
secret_help: Masked. DB uses DPAPI. Not shown in the sidebar
day_help: Calendar. DB stores Unix seconds at 00:00 UTC
moment_help: Date and time. DB stores Unix seconds UTC
mode_help: (value, label) list. get_config returns a string
style_help: Enum members. DB stores the name. get_config returns the member
face_help: Font combo. DB stores the family name
charset_help: Codec name. utf-8 / cp932 / shift_jis / latin_1 come first
language_help: Language code. Labels use native names
country_help: Country code. Labels use native country names
need_text_help: required. OK / Apply stay disabled while empty
need_texts_help: required and multiple. Zero items is empty
